title: FDR on financial interests owning America
summary: JASON tells of FDR on financial interests owning America, about 1930s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he he said to in a in a conversation or letter that he wrote that the financial interests had owned America since the time of Andrew Jackson.

plain: A speaker identified only as JASON says on Jesse Michels' podcast that Franklin D. Roosevelt, the US president of the 1930s, wrote in a letter or said in a conversation that financial interests had owned America since the days of President Andrew Jackson. He brings it up in an episode arguing that the UFO cover-up leads back to a single secret society.
